column1: # Forms of address, name particles and connectors for the Tier 2 languages. Our own lists, written from general usage in each language; they
# only make the rendered strings look like real ones (the pairing of a title with the sex of the sampled given name is never a label).
# kind <TAB> language <TAB> text <TAB> sex of the given name it pairs with (M, F, -) <TAB> dot-optional (1) or fixed spelling (0) <TAB> weight
#   particle: a family-name particle written in lower case between the given and the family name (weight in the last column)
#   mr, mrs, dr, and: the strings of several-people forms ("Herr und Frau Müller"): mr = him, mrs = her, dr = doctor, and = connector
# Languages without a particle line get no particle examples; Slavic and Hungarian feminine family-name forms come from the sources, not from rules.
